Looks like we're in this mysterious force's lair..
Who ever is behind this is going on the naughty list!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 18 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Papa Bread''' was a tanky enemy that first appeared in the third phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a high amount of health but was quite slow. It most often spawned in front of the [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elfs]], and acted as a shield for them, which made them a possibly deadly combination. It was also immune to being stunned by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]], and could only be slowed down by them. It could be spawned by [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability. ==Appearance== '''Papa Bread''' was a dark brown gingerbread man with a festive pattern apron, a festive chef's hat and a brown wooden ladle strapped on its back. Its rig had a waist and lower arms. Its cylindrical head consisted of a smile and two eyes made from icing. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]], are highly effective against '''Papa Bread'''. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers respectively. *As '''Papa Bread''' tends to spawn in groups, towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] are effective against it. **These towers can also be useful at clearing out other enemies that spawn alongside it and dealing damage to [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elfs]] that most often spawn behind groups of '''Papa Breads'''. *'''Papa Bread''' cannot be stunned by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]], though it can still be slowed down by them. **Additionally, freezing towers like the [[Freezer]] or [[Cryomancer]] can only freeze it for a shorter amount of time because of its large size. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PapaBreadWalk.gif|Walking animation (21 December 2023 – 31 January 2024) }} ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Papa Bread''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Papa Bread''' removed. {{KrampusFrosthold|[[Cookie Guard (Krampus Frosthold)|Cookie Guard]] & [[Gatekeeper (Krampus Frosthold)|Gatekeeper]]|Wave 17|Papa Bread, [[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]] & [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elf]]|Wave 18|[[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elf]], [[Sleigh (Krampus Frosthold)|Sleigh]], [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldier]] & [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Papa Bread}}
